front.title: A YANG Data Model for Network Incident Diagnostic Assessments

abstract.t:
This document defines a YANG data model for diagnosis-specific assessment records associated with network incidents. The model augments the network incident model with a history of diagnostic assessments that relate evidence to probable-cause hypotheses, record inconclusive or blocked diagnostic outcomes, and capture post- remediation verification observations.
The model complements rather than replaces generic task interfaces. Generic task lifecycle, planning, confirmation, execution, and task- notification mechanisms are not redefined.
